title: Finite locally free tensor-pullback unit
statement: Let $p:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme]. For the canonical tensor-pullback adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], suppose the unit on $\mathcal O_Y$ is invertible. Then the unit on any finite locally free $\mathcal O_Y$-module $N$ [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf] is invertible.

source.place: Tag 01E8, degree-zero projection formula and local finite-free proof; Tag 0BDP, projection-formula paragraph

proof.text:
Cover Y by opens U on which N is free with a finite basis of size r. Direct
image restricts to the full inverse image of U, and tensor pullback along U's inclusion
is restriction. The defining section formula for the chosen adjunction unit is
m ↦ 1 ⊗ m. Both tensor pullback and direct image preserve finite direct sums, so in
these coordinates the unit at N is the direct sum of r copies of the restricted
unit at O_Y. The latter is an isomorphism by hypothesis. Hence the unit at N is
invertible on each U, and inverses glue by uniqueness. For r = 0 the unit is the
identity of the zero object. If Y is empty, the assertion is vacuous locally. Uses [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf].

    (N : Y.Modules) [N.IsFiniteLocallyFree] :
